content: The two best T-shirts I saw at MagicCon: Atlanta 2026 were easy to choose in a sea of delightfully nerdy references and imagery. One was black with a wall of white text spelling out the lengthy definition of Banding, a notoriously confusing Magic: The Gathering mechanic that’s now 33 years old. The other was a white shirt featuring a picture of a Sol Ring card crossed out by a red circle and slash. “BAN SOL RING,” it read.
